scope.coverage: Monash common coursework programs expanded across five disciplines and three Handbook years; other universities remain representative samples.
scope.notice: Program pages are indexed only after download and extraction checks. A catalog match alone does not count as ready coverage.

retrieval_policy.strategy: download immutable local snapshots before parsing and indexing
retrieval_policy.refresh_mode: explicit scheduled refresh with hash comparison
retrieval_policy.publish_policy: source changes require parsing review and regression tests before publication

historical_notes.note: Adelaide University commenced teaching in 2026. Earlier handbooks belong to predecessor institutions and must be modelled as separate sources.
The current handbook page is year-bound in page content rather than URL. UWA also publishes a dedicated 2024/2025 comparison document.
